title: Global lunar Mg/Si and Al/Si weight-ratio maps from Chandrayaan-2 CLASS using GOES solar spectra
description: Processing chain, data products and manuscript source for global lunar Mg/Si and Al/Si weight-ratio maps from Chandrayaan-2 CLASS X-ray fluorescence spectra. Every Level-1 spectrum is fitted on raw counts with a Poisson (Cash) likelihood using a simplified fundamental-parameter forward model (primary and secondary fluorescence with matrix effects, scattered solar spectrum, distributed CLASS ancillary response, in-flight detector calibration per detector-temperature bin, particle-background template). The incident solar spectrum is an isothermal CHIANTI spectrum at the GOES XRS temperature of each exposure. Includes per-footprint results of the quality-0 mapping set and of a second epoch, 2-degree maps with quality layers, per-month calibrations, validation against Apollo/Luna and Chang'E/Chandrayaan-3 sites and Lunar Prospector GRS, an epoch repeatability test, and a comparison with Chandrayaan-2 XSM solar spectra. Version 2.1.0 accompanies the revised manuscript (Advances in Space Research, revision 1); src/asr/reproduce_release.py regenerates Table 5 and Figures 1, 4 and 7 from the archived products.
